node.title: BAND CHILD 2 (RH-AC): locate the rate-half adjacent crossing a_RH(q) on every unresolved row
node.statement: For every admissible rate-half row n=2^41, k=2^40, q=p^e with e in {1,...,6} and 2^167<q<2^256, determine the adjacent MCA crossing a_RH(q) satisfying B_mca(a_RH)<=floor(q/2^128)<B_mca(a_RH-1). The proved lower endpoint is k+2^34. On razor rows the proved direct-MCA Haboeck bounds give upper endpoints a_94=1563215236073 and, above the printed threshold, a_95=1563128173124. The far-CA/sparse crossing and adjacent unsafe witness remain open. In the endpoint analysis, every strict A=3 moving-kernel profile, every A=1 fixed-core-two profile, and every A=1 degree below 183251937963 are excluded. The remaining positive-slack A=1 core-free and core-one ranges share that first degree. At the first degree there are exactly six core/slack profiles, with T in {rho+2,rho+3,rho+4}. The key mechanism is scheme-theoretic Forney pole absorption: the Forney numerator belongs to (H:G), so direct three-contact vanishing forces ell>=e-3+beta without an auxiliary pole clearer. Independently, the capacity route requires spend 9m/4+1 officially. The proved two-type-1 projective-fibre argument supplies only 2m+1 and the exact cap 9m/2; reaching the closing spend through that bound requires the two fibres to total at least 25m/4, an additional m/4 beyond their automatic baseline. An incidence countermodel fences support-only FR, while a root-counting obstruction shows that countermodel has no coset-preserving apolar-biform lift. The adjacent unsafe witness also remains open.
node.attack_surface: Prioritize the six first-degree A=1 corners at e=ceil((rho-1)/3), separately for s=0,1 and T=rho+2,rho+3,rho+4. Exploit exact Forney pole absorption and the boundary cases ell=e-3+beta through e-1+beta; do not continue the now-excluded cubic-residual corner at e=floor(16m/13). Then extend the mechanism to higher e. Core two, every sharp-cap profile, and all lower degrees are closed. Seek a stronger contact product only with a proved restriction-sequence or divisor gain, not by formal iteration. In parallel, seek a theorem forcing two-fibre mass at least 25m/4 or a collective inequality for realizable shortened-apolar families. Keep the endpoint calibrated to outside spend 9m/4+1 (clean intersection at most 7m/4-2). Do not continue strict A=3 geometry, the excluded A=1 prefixes, the historical reciprocal corrected-square classifier, the refuted wide-radius single-generator extension, the incidence-only FR route, stop at the insufficient two-type-1 spend 2m+1, or re-audit the fenced quartic countermodel. Independently seek a beyond-Johnson direct MCA upper bound or an exact adjacent unsafe family. Preserve the q=p^e scope and do not substitute ordinary LIST supply for MCA without a proved beyond-half-distance conversion.
node.falsifier: An admissible row outside the printed bracket; a received word violating a proposed safe numerator; a claimed adjacent-unsafe family that fails exact slope count, endpoint, field, or ownership checks; or a purported FR proof using only the fenced incidence axioms.
